From 80a2d9df1dfd63b5fab631b8b9966164ed647adf Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Ulises=20Gasc=C3=B3n?= <ulisesgascongonzalez@gmail.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 13:52:04 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] fix: swallow late busboy error after teardown

Ref: https://github.com/expressjs/multer/security/advisories/GHSA-q7qp-rjg7-q26m

Co-authored-by: Sebastian Beltran <bjohansebas@gmail.com>
---
 lib/make-middleware.js                   |  3 +
 test/async-file-filter-teardown-crash.js | 76 ++++++++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 79 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 test/async-file-filter-teardown-crash.js

diff --git a/lib/make-middleware.js b/lib/make-middleware.js
index 6be71a15..1cce8e1a 100644
--- a/lib/make-middleware.js
+++ b/lib/make-middleware.js
@@ -160,6 +160,9 @@ function makeMiddleware (setup) {
         req.unpipe(busboy)
         setImmediate(() => {
           busboy.removeAllListeners()
+          // Keep an error listener so a late busboy error after teardown cannot
+          // crash the process; the request has already finished.
+          busboy.on('error', function () {})
         })
       }
       drainStream(req)
diff --git a/test/async-file-filter-teardown-crash.js b/test/async-file-filter-teardown-crash.js
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..9c4c6c1e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/async-file-filter-teardown-crash.js
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+/* eslint-env mocha */
+
+var assert = require('assert')
+var stream = require('stream')
+var multer = require('../')
+
+// @see https://github.com/expressjs/multer/security/advisories/GHSA-q7qp-rjg7-q26m
+
+describe('async fileFilter late resume after teardown', function () {
+  it('does not crash the process when a pending fileFilter resumes a parked stream after teardown', function (done) {
+    var req = new stream.PassThrough()
+    var filterError = new Error('file rejected')
+    var resumeFilter
+    var busboy
+    var nextCalls = 0
+    var boundary = 'TeardownBoundary'
+    var body = [
+      '--' + boundary,
+      'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="first"; filename="first.txt"',
+      'Content-Type: text/plain',
+      '',
+      'a',
+      '--' + boundary,
+      'Content-Disposition: form-data; name="second"; filename="second.txt"',
+      'Content-Type: text/plain',
+      '',
+      'b'
+      // No closing boundary: busboy will fail when its pending write completes.
+    ].join('\r\n')
+
+    var upload = multer({
+      fileHwm: 1,
+      streamHandler: function (req, parser) {
+        busboy = parser
+        req.pipe(parser)
+      },
+      fileFilter: function (req, file, cb) {
+        if (file.fieldname === 'first') {
+          resumeFilter = cb
+        } else {
+          // Let req end and queue busboy's finalization behind the parked write.
+          req.once('end', function () {
+            setImmediate(function () { cb(filterError) })
+          })
+        }
+      }
+    }).any()
+
+    req.headers = {
+      'content-type': 'multipart/form-data; boundary=' + boundary,
+      'content-length': Buffer.byteLength(body)
+    }
+
+    upload(req, null, function (err) {
+      nextCalls++
+      assert.strictEqual(err, filterError)
+      assert.strictEqual(typeof resumeFilter, 'function')
+
+      // done() queued listener removal before next(), so this runs after teardown.
+      setImmediate(function () {
+        // Observe completion without adding an error listener that masks the bug.
+        busboy.once('close', function () {
+          assert.strictEqual(nextCalls, 1)
+          assert.deepStrictEqual(req.files, [])
+          done()
+        })
+
+        // Resuming the real file stream lets busboy report the truncated form.
+        resumeFilter(null, true)
+      })
+    })
+
+    // One write ensures both file headers are parsed while the first is parked.
+    req.end(body)
+  })
+})
